clayresearch.delta: Safe-effect geometry should treat replay/recovery receipt completeness as part of protected auditability, while retaining real concurrency tests outside the deterministic oracle.

frank.delta: Add a logical Receipt-Sealed Determinism Envelope to trace_replay_recovery: every semantically relevant clock/random/model/peer/tool/sensor/capability/scheduler/effect outcome is either deterministic from frozen state or bound as an explicit receipt. This is a logical contract, not necessarily a new deploy-time module.

gwt.delta: Workspace/receiver MeasurementReceipts must bind state epoch, episode/intervention identity and every nondeterministic input that can change competition, reconstruction, uptake, causal use or re-entry; replay success remains distinct from causal support.

emergenz.delta: Matched counterfactuals require receipt closure so non-intervention exogenous differences cannot masquerade as lesion/rescue/re-entry effects. Deterministic replay is a prerequisite/oracle, not emergence evidence itself.

claycode.delta: BASE effect/runtime semantics should support semantic receipt identity distinct from execution trace identity; external effects need typed idempotency/queryability classification and an explicit COMMIT_UNKNOWN/reconciliation path when commit status is ambiguous.

hyperposition.delta: Timing/order/schedule belongs in semantic identity only when it changes non-commuting state transitions or declared program-observable behavior; otherwise preserve it in trace/provenance identity to avoid false semantic divergence.

claygraph.delta: Dynamic Run ClayGraph should carry causal edge order plus receipt references and semantic pre/post hashes; latency/retry metadata may remain trace-only unless contractually semantic. Graph differential should compare normalized semantic causality, not byte-identical execution logs.

unifieddb.delta: Persist effect-id/reservation/commit/outcome/re-entry lineage with explicit ambiguous commit status; use canonical semantic snapshots/epochs while treating derived execution telemetry as separately hashed evidence. Never infer external success from local intent/reservation alone.

harness.delta: A coarse event log is insufficient in the synthetic discriminator: omitting any one semantically relevant nondeterminism source produced near-universal replay divergence. Golden Traces need a receipt-closure matrix and H1/H2 differential must distinguish semantic hashes from execution-trace hashes.

cross_branch_negative_results: Do not globally serialize/determinize the entire production runtime merely to make replay easy.
Do not count deterministic simulation as coverage for real thread/race failures.
Do not equate successful replay with causal emergence evidence.
Do not claim exactly-once for arbitrary non-idempotent external effects without dedupe/query/transactional coupling or explicit ambiguity handling.
